description: Write a whole number or VND amount (0 to 10^15) in words, in Vietnamese (as on invoices and payment orders: lẻ or linh for a zero tens digit, mốt, tư, lăm; nghìn, triệu, tỷ; optional "đồng chẵn") and in English. Examples: {"amount":1234567891}; {"amount":105,"language":"vi","vi_zero":"linh"}; {"amount":25000000,"vi_chan":true,"capitalize":true}.

capitalize.description: Capitalize the first letter. Default false.

currency.description: Append the currency ("đồng" / "dong"). Default true; false gives the bare number.

vi_chan.description: Vietnamese only: end with "đồng chẵn" (an exact amount), as on payment documents. Default false.

vi_zero.description: Vietnamese word for a zero tens digit: "lẻ" (default) or "linh", e.g. 105 = một trăm lẻ năm.

name: amount_in_words
title: Amount in words (Vietnamese and English)
